questions: Where does the current `hlx library show` handler discard the body content, and is the full content already available in memory?
What is the established pattern for adding boolean CLI flags in this codebase?
Does `cmdShow` already receive the CLI args array needed to check for `--full`?
Which files need documentation updates to satisfy the acceptance criteria?

answers.answer: cmdShow() in src/library/show.ts fetches the full item via hxFetch at line 24, producing a LibraryItemDetail with content: string | null. The rendering loop (lines 43-64) iterates all lines but only prints heading matches; line 62 has an explicit comment '// Skip non-heading content for brevity'. The full markdown body is already in memory — it is simply not printed.
evidence: src/library/show.ts:24 — hxFetch call returns LibraryItemDetail with item.content
src/library/show.ts:44-63 — loop splits content into lines, regex-matches headings, skips everything else
src/library/show.ts:62 — comment: '// Skip non-heading content for brevity'

answers.answer: The codebase uses hasFlag(args, '--flagname') from src/lib/flags.ts (line 11-13) as the standard pattern for boolean CLI flags. It is used consistently across 7+ call sites for --json, --dry-run, --archived, --force, --current.

Yes. cmdShow's third parameter is _args: string[] (line 23), which receives the rest array from the router (src/library/index.ts:44). It is unused (underscore prefix convention). Renaming to args and calling hasFlag(args, '--full') requires no plumbing changes.
evidence: src/library/show.ts:23 — function signature: cmdShow(config, resolvedId, _args: string[])

answers.answer: Four documentation locations are relevant: (1) src/library/index.ts:39 — help text for 'hlx library show' needs [--full] added, (2) src/index.ts:55 — top-level usage text should mention --full, (3) skill-content/references/commands.md:300-308 — CLI reference section explicitly required by acceptance criteria, (4) skill-content/SKILL.md — high-level skill overview mentions library but probably does not need detail changes.
evidence: src/index.ts:55 — 'hlx library show <ref>          Show report with section annotations'
skill-content/references/commands.md:300-308 — show command section documents current behavior only
skill-content/SKILL.md:44 — '| `library` | Browse and rate published research reports |'

statement: The root cause is a deliberate design omission: cmdShow() in src/library/show.ts already fetches the full markdown body via /api/library/items/:id but its rendering loop (lines 43-64) only prints heading lines, explicitly discarding all other content. The function receives the CLI args array but ignores it (underscore-prefixed _args). The fix is to rename _args to args, import hasFlag, and conditionally print the full body when --full is set. Four files need changes: show.ts (logic), index.ts (help text), src/index.ts (usage text), and skill-content/references/commands.md (skill documentation). No API changes, no new dependencies, no new HTTP calls needed.
